items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: play with Max Roach and Clifford Brown and Charlie Parker

ctx.x: … So all this time, I hadn't started playing jazz yet, but I had a combo locally around my house. The drummer, [I think] his name was Johnny, he liked to mess around with cars, fixing up his car, and he played drums as a hobby and he left his drums down in my basement. This is during the time when my uncle had the jazz records. So I used to get these jazz records and go down to the basement and play with Max Roach and Clifford Brown and Charlie Parker, Mal Waldron, Jackie McLean, Art Blakey, Miles Davis and…
So you’re just working it out yourself? You didn't have anyone showing you anything?
